decisions.name: 1-date-fns-same-day-bug-baseline
decisions.notes: Every effective finished input, source diff and additive tests reviewed. Single final edit12 restores calendar-day comparison while retaining all imports/interfaces/context normalization. Types13 and exact selection14 pass after final edit, fifteen cases. Five meaningful new cases include month/year, invalid/immutability, timestamps/strings and timezone context; input-source countercheck fails. Later diff/status only read source. Raw npm route has no catalog/test observation in F13, but actual checks pass. No retrieval or supervisor repair.
